faqs.q: How does the Kurt Crimp Hydraulic Hose Fittings with Flange Connection differ from the Eaton Crimp Hydraulic Hose Fittings with Flange Connection?
faqs.a: The Kurt Crimp Hydraulic Hose Fittings with Flange Connection and the [Eaton Crimp Hydraulic Hose Fittings with Flange Connection](/p/eaton-crimp-hydraulic-hose-fittings-with-flange-connection) are two listings in the same range. They differ in brand Kurt here against Eaton Aeroquip. Choose by the thread on your port and the hose, then confirm both in the size tables.

faqs.q: Can I buy the Kurt Crimp Hydraulic Hose Fittings with Flange Connection from stock in the UAE and get a quotation?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep the Kurt Crimp Hydraulic Hose Fittings with Flange Connection in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
